programmes.d: A government assassin receives the order to eliminate his partner.
Four women run a private child support clinic by day but are collectors at night. Seeking out deadbeat parents and using seduction and force to make them pay up.
Two friends try to bring down a human trafficking ring while dealing with the death of a lover and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict.

Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

Talia forges a new life for her and her daughter, Hope, after leaving her abusive husband. When Hope begins experiencing troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as "The Chosen Soul."

programmes.t: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
programmes.d: Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful drug lord, when he learns the payout could cover his dying mother's medical bills. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

When women start disappearing all over the city, Detective Powell and Scott take on the case hoping to bring the culprit to justice. Can they find the elusive killer or will it be to late for the next victim.
After a tragedy near Christmas, two boys' lives are turned upside down, and they end up in the home of Ms. Mary.

Thomas had the perfect life until he lost his wife and son. After a ground-breaking surgery he is given an implant that allows him to create his own virtual reality. When the implant malfunctions, Thomas discovers a dark, long-forgotten secret.

A despairing group of Christians and non-believer's band together during the biblical period, known as Tribulation, not only to survive death, but to escape America, and uncover a sinister globalist plot designed by an overreaching government.
There is no "Heartbreak 101" or Graduate-level Backstabbing Courses on the syllabus, and nothing covered in a classroom can prepare you for the harsh realities of the real world.

Brandon and Leo are two friends stuck at a dead-end job, until their boss gets arrested and the two seem to be on the upswing. Now between hiding from the IRS, a rival dealership, the road back to respectability is a long and bumpy road.

A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother?s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.
